verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is distributed as an open GitHub repository. Its docs describe running an unpublished local checkout through a local marketplace path, and a Nix flake builds the portable layout, so the core skills can be run from your own copy. There is no explicit self-hosting documentation, though, and the skills depend on the YYLO CLI and Ledger, whose self-hostability is not evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting docs, a stated open-source license, evidence that the YYLO CLI/Ledger backend can be self-hosted, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: To validate an unpublished checkout without changing your normal settings, use an isolated configuration directory and a local marketplace path
The Nix flake builds the portable layout
This repository is the canonical, independently versioned source for skills used by YYLO CLI, YYLO Ledger and YYLO Benchmark.
